components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive waitlist action on dark surfaces.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Unirme a la lista de espera</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { appearance: none; border: 0; border-radius: .75rem; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #109d8f, #22b8a8); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(34,184,168,.24); color: #031016; cursor: pointer; font: 600 .875rem/1.25 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: .75rem 1.25rem; transition: transform 240ms ease, box-shadow 240ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px -24px rgba(45,212,191,.45); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2dd4bf; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Dark Field
components.description: A high-contrast waitlist field with a clear focus state.
components.css: .ds-field-label { color: #dbe5f1; display: grid; font: 500 .875rem/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; gap: .5rem; } .ds-field { background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); border-radius: .75rem; color: #f8fafc; font: 400 1rem/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: .65rem .8rem; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-field:focus-visible { background: rgba(255,255,255,.07); border-color: rgba(45,212,191,.7); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,212,191,.22); outline: none; }

narrative.overview: Comelu combines the measured confidence of a well-calibrated laboratory instrument with the clarity of contemporary product communication. The interface feels clinically clean and technically fluent without becoming sterile, bureaucratic, or futuristic.

rules.name: The Measured Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal carries intent. Keep it rare enough that action, focus, or status remains instantly recognizable.

rules.name: The Evidence-First Type Rule
rules.body: Headlines state practical value plainly; supporting copy explains the workflow without hype.

rules.name: The Layered-Not-Glossy Rule
rules.body: Use one subtle atmospheric gradient or soft shadow to establish hierarchy; do not stack effects into glass tiles.

dos: Do use dark navy to frame the promise and light paper for explanatory content.
Do use teal with disciplined restraint.
Do pair every interactive state with visible focus and semantic labeling.
donts: Don't turn the system into generic enterprise software or speculative AI aesthetics.
Don't introduce heavy gradients or pervasive glassmorphism.
Don't rely on color, hover, animation, or pointer precision as the only interaction cue.
